answer_1.quote: a multi-task benchmark containing high-quality datasets for six real-world NLP tasks: machine translation (MT), open-domain dialogue (DG), dialogue summarization (DS), intent detection (ID), stance classification (SC), and safety detection (SD).
answer_1.outputs: Binary classification predictions for validity of targets (e.g., translations, responses, summaries).

answer_2.quote: We evaluate models on CRoW using two scores: Macro-F1 of predicting valid and invalid targets, and Situational Accuracy, a stringent metric that reports whether the model correctly identifies the validity (or invalidity) of all targets for a given context.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation. We evaluate the human performance on each task of the benchmark using two expert annotators who evaluate 100 random samples from the task.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators classified whether targets were valid for contexts using task-specific criteria (e.g., plausibility for dialogue, correctness for translation). Disagreements were resolved through discussion.
